text:
(ESA 2025) Insert detached sentences 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 into the right gaps of the text. The parentheses ( ) show where the gaps are in the text.
DETACHED SENTENCES
1. This firepower increases the Army's ability to engage in fight, provide fire support to ground forces, and suppress enemy positions effectively.
2. This has proven instrumental in saving lives during natural disasters, assisting civil authorities in emergency situations, and supporting humanitarian missions.
3. In summary, the Brazilian Army's adoption of the Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters has
revolutionized its operational capabilities.
4. This capability supports the Brazilian Army's tactical and logistical needs with rapid deployment of troops, equipment, and supplies to any location across the country, including remote and inaccessible areas.
THE BLACK HAWK IN THE BRAZILIAN ARMY AVIATION
The Brazilian Army has successfully incorporated the use of the Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters into its operations. This versatile aircraft has proven to be a game-changer, enhancing the Army's capabilities across various missions and improving the efficiency of its operations. One of the key advantages of the Black Hawk is its ability to operate in diverse terrains and challenging conditions. ( ). The Black Hawk can navigate with its powerful engines through these different environments. The Black Hawk has demonstrated its agility in Brazil's diverse terrains performing close air support, troop transport, or search and rescue missions.
The helicopter's capacity to carry personnel and cargo is impressive. With its spacious cabin, the Black Hawk can transport 11 equipped soldiers or carry a payload of 2,600 kilograms. ( )
Furthermore, the Black Hawk's advanced weapon systems and communication equipment enhance the Brazilian Army's combat capabilities. Armed variants of the helicopter can carry and deploy machine guns, rockets, and guided missiles. ( ) Moreover, the integration of modern communication systems ensures seamless coordination between the helicopter crew and ground units, improving situational awareness and mission success.
The use of Black Hawk helicopters has also significantly enhanced the Brazilian Army's search and rescue capabilities. Equipped with advanced sensor systems and night-vision technology, the aircraft can conduct rescue operations in adverse weather conditions, during night-time hours, and in remote areas, where traditional means are often insufficient. ( )
( ) Its versatility, cargo capacity, firepower, and search and rescue capabilities have proved invaluable in a variety of missions. The Black Hawk's integration into the Army's fleet has strengthened its ability to defend the nation, support peacekeeping efforts, and effectively respond to threats and emergencies, making it an indispensable asset for the Brazilian military.
subject: Inglês
explanation:
1. CERTA, como os comentários a seguir comprovam.



1ª lacuna (logo após “challenging conditions.”)

One of the key advantages of the Black Hawk is its ability to operate in diverse terrains and challenging conditions. ( ). The Black Hawk can navigate with its powerful engines through these different environments.

A sentença que fala sobre os diferentes tipos de terreno do Brasil se encaixa perfeitamente aqui:

(5) Brazil's vast and varied landscape encompasses dense jungles, rugged mountains, and extensive coastlines.
(“A vasta e variada paisagem do Brasil abrange selvas densas, montanhas acidentadas e extensas linhas costeiras.”)


2ª lacuna (após “payload of 2,600 kilograms.”)

With its spacious cabin, the Black Hawk can transport 11 equipped soldiers or carry a payload of 2,600 kilograms. ( ).

A ideia que segue logicamente é a vantagem logística e tática da capacidade de transporte:

(4) This capability supports the Brazilian Army's tactical and logistical needs with rapid deployment of troops, equipment, and supplies to any location across the country, including remote and inaccessible areas.
(“Essa capacidade apoia as necessidades táticas e logísticas do Exército Brasileiro com o rápido deslocamento de tropas, equipamentos e suprimentos para qualquer local do país, inclusive áreas remotas e inacessíveis.”)

3ª lacuna (após “mission success.”)

Armed variants of the helicopter can carry and deploy machine guns, rockets, and guided missiles. ( ). Moreover, the integration of modern communication systems...

Aqui cabe a frase que fala sobre poder de fogo e apoio em combate:

(1) This firepower increases the Army's ability to engage in fight, provide fire support to ground forces, and suppress enemy positions effectively.
(“Esse poder de fogo aumenta a capacidade do Exército de engajar-se em combate, fornecer apoio de fogo às forças terrestres e suprimir posições inimigas de forma eficaz.”)


4ª lacuna (após “traditional means are often insufficient.”)

The use of Black Hawk helicopters has also significantly enhanced the Brazilian Army's search and rescue capabilities... ( ).

Aqui se fala sobre operações de resgate e ajuda humanitária, então a frase correta é:

(2) This has proven instrumental in saving lives during natural disasters, assisting civil authorities in emergency situations, and supporting humanitarian missions.
(“Isso tem se mostrado fundamental para salvar vidas durante desastres naturais, auxiliar autoridades civis em situações de emergência e apoiar missões humanitárias.”)


5ª lacuna (último parágrafo)

( ). Its versatility, cargo capacity, firepower, and search and rescue capabilities have proved invaluable...

Aqui é o momento de síntese e conclusão do texto:

(3) In summary, the Brazilian Army's adoption of the Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters has revolutionized its operational capabilities.
(“Em resumo, a adoção dos helicópteros Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk pelo Exército Brasileiro revolucionou suas capacidades operacionais.”)
